verdict.rationale: AFK's docs mention tasks becoming directed graphs with parallel branches running concurrently and blocked nodes resuming when dependencies clear, which implies some branching/merging logic, but there is no explicit mention of conditional logic, filters, or a visual builder UI for constructing these branches as an ops user would configure. missing for 10: explicit conditional/filter configuration by ops users, visual workflow builder interface evidence, merge-back behavior detail, independent/hands-on corroboration.
